dialogues.speaker: Less-Than-Legible Notes
dialogues.text: "Creating murals in places where paint is produced is indeed a good idea. When we repair them, we can <color=#00E1FFFF>just grab the relevant material on the spot and fill the missing paints in</color>..."

dialogues.speaker: Less-Than-Legible Notes
dialogues.text: "...The story couldn't possibly end just as the three tribal warriors were defeated by Rumi the wicked sorcerer. Could the mural in which Kuntur appears be somewhere else?..."

dialogues.speaker: Less-Than-Legible Notes
dialogues.text: "...I can't find the path. Has it been buried? Or is there some sort of mechanism at play here..."
